name: Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu ~Rinne Tensei Hen~
original_name: 白と黒の伝説 ～輪廻転生編～
source: The second part of the "Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu" tells the story of the victims of the Bermuda Triangle, which was pulled into the distant past. To get back to their world, the crew of the ship will visit the ruins of Atlantis, medieval Europe, ancient Japan, and fight demons.
translation: 《白与黑之传说》第二部讲述了被拉回到遥远过去的百慕大三角受害者的故事。为了回到他们的世界，船员们将参观亚特兰蒂斯遗址、中世纪欧洲、古代日本，并与恶魔战斗。
